   1| ## 6. Refund decision
   2| 
   3| A customer asks for a refund in the support portal of Mossgiel Outfitters.
   4| This section decides every refund request. The checks R6.1, R6.2 and R6.3 run in this order.
   5| 
   6| ### 6.1 Rules
   7| 
   8| - **R6.1** A request made more than 30 days after delivery is declined.
   9|   An item that the customer reports as defective goes to a support agent, regardless of its age.
  10| - **R6.2** A digital good is refundable only if it has not been downloaded.
  11|   R6.2 applies to digital goods only.
  12| - **R6.3** A refund of $50 or less is approved automatically.
  13| - **R6.4** A refund above $50 goes to a support agent, who approves or declines it.
  14| - **R6.5** A refund above $500 that a support agent approves also needs a team lead.
  15|   The team lead approves or declines it.
  16| - **R6.6** An approved refund goes back to the original payment method.
  17| 
  18| The support portal records every decision in the history of the request.
  19| 
  20| ### 6.2 Limits from other sections
  21| 
  22| | Subject | Limit | Section |
  23| | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  24| | Exchange of an item | within 60 days of delivery | §5 |
  25| | Store credit | up to $200, issued instantly | §7 |
  26| | Answer of a support agent | within 2 business days | §7 |
  27| | Payout to the customer | within 5 business days | §7 |
  28| 
  29| These limits do not change the refund decision of §6.1.
=== END docs/specs/support-policy.md ===
